info.name: Marketplace Customer API (v1)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the customer-facing API at `routes/api_customer.php` (Laravel app, guard: `customer` JWT). Base path: `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost:8000/api/customer`).

Most routes are prefixed `v1/{{country}}/...` where `{{country}}` is a site_code resolved by the `detect.country` middleware into a Country model. A handful of groups are country-agnostic (`v1/nawy`, `v1/app`, `v1/orders`, `v1/wallet`, `v1/gift-cards`, `v1/warranty`, `v1/otp`, `v1/listings`, `v1/reviews`, `v1/device-tokens`, `v1/countries`, `v1/shipping-methods`) and scope data by the authenticated `customer_id` (or take `country_id` as a query param for public ones).

**Auth flow**: Run **Auth > Register** or **Auth > Login** first. Their Test scripts automatically save the returned `access_token`/`refresh_token` into collection variables, and the collection-level Authorization (Bearer `{{access_token}}`) is inherited by every other request — no manual copy/paste needed. **Auth > Refresh Token** re-saves both tokens too.

**Response envelope**: all endpoints (except a few raw `response()->json()` stubs) return `{ success: bool, message: string, data?: any, errors?: object }`. Paginated list endpoints wrap `data` as `{ items: [...], meta: { current_page, last_page, per_page, total } }`.

**Stub controllers** (always 501 Not Implemented): `POST/v1/otp/send`, `POST /v1/otp/verify`, `POST /v1/reviews`, `GET /v1/reviews/mine`, `POST /v1/device-tokens`, `GET /v1/countries`, `GET /v1/shipping-methods` — each has a working, non-stub equivalent elsewhere in the collection (see each stub request's description for the pointer).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, password reset, email verification. Run Register or Login first — their Test scripts auto-save {{access_token}} / {{refresh_token}} for every other authenticated request in this collection.

request.description:
Registers a new customer account, issues an access/refresh JWT token pair, and dispatches an email verification job.

**Body fields**

| Field | Type | Required | Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| name | string | yes | max:255 | Customer full name |
| email | string | yes | email, max:255, unique:customers,email | Login email |
| phone | string | no | max:20, unique:customers,phone | Login/contact phone |
| password | string | yes | min:8, confirmed | Plaintext password (must match password_confirmation) |
| password_confirmation | string | yes (if password sent) | must equal password | Confirmation field required by `confirmed` rule |
| referral_code | string | no | size:8 | Referring customer's 8-char referral code |

On success (201) returns `customer`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `token_type`, `expires_in`. The collection Test script on this request auto-saves `access_token`/`refresh_token` as collection variables.
